items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ガチアサリの毎tick総アサリ数集計で `Object.values()` 配列を生成しない
items.reason: Clam totals walk own inventory records directly with the original numeric rules, avoiding Object.values materialization.

prior1870.reason: Iterate own enumerable inventory entries directly in the same key order without constructing Object.values.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ガチアサリ共通 `vec` の検証用 `slice(0,3)` 一時配列を減らす
items.reason: The first three coordinates are validated directly without slice/every allocation and with the same accepted input shape.

prior1870.reason: Use eager scalar validation for ordinary coordinate arrays; sparse slots, inherited elements, custom slice/species behavior and unusual inputs retain the prior semantics.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ガチアサリの3D描画でドリルがないときのフィールド配列コピーを省略する
items.reason: The field-list snapshot precedes callbacks that can mutate the live list. Deferring it to only the drill path would change ordinary traversal visibility.

prior1870.reason: Mesh/Object3D add callbacks can synchronously mutate source array; shallow snapshot preserves current iteration boundary. Local small-N regression also reported.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ranked-grounded-clam-pickup-exact-axis-broadphase
items.reason: Grounded pickup uses exact axis broadphase before its existing radius calculation; team, capacity and ordered pickup semantics remain unchanged.

prior1870.reason: Use conservative axis rejection only at the actual pickup callsite; the general distance helper retains its exact numeric return contract.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Hostのガチルール単発内部イベントで空の送信用 `filter` 配列を生成しない
items.reason: A single internal nonwire host event avoids filter allocation; public/wire lists and multi-event ordering keep their original path.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ガチホコバリアの攻撃種別が正規キーの場合だけ文字列正規化を省略
items.reason: Canonical barrier weapon kinds use the direct table; unknown kinds retain the existing normalization/fallback.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ホコバリア証拠の期限掃除で毎回作る `filter()` 配列をなくす
items.reason: Expired barrier proofs are stably pruned in place without changing receipt ownership or validation gates.

prior1870.reason: Compact owner-private expired proof and pending lists in place, preserving order and bounded admission counts.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ガチホコ3Dモデル：未変更の発光色・強度を毎フレーム再設定しない
items.reason: Unchanged emissive state avoids duplicate material writes; material replacement and externally changed RGB values invalidate the cache and are restored correctly.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ガチホコ拾得・チェックポイント・ゴール接触の遠距離 `hypot` を厳密な軸判定で省略
items.reason: Pickup/checkpoint/goal interactions use finite exact-axis far rejection before the original distance calculation, preserving threshold decisions and malformed-value fallback.

prior1870.reason: Conditional broadphase needs trusted stable triples; verifying custom/foreign inputs and near-heavy performance remains necessary.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ガチホコ発射ベクトル正規化で短命 `.map` 配列を省略
items.reason: The private freshly owned shot aim is normalized in place; shared/public input aim vectors are not mutated.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ガチホコ弾の塗り軌跡：垂直レイ用Vector3のサンプル単位生成を省略
items.reason: Vertical paint probes use per-depth shot scratch with finally release. Escaping paint points still receive independent copies.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ガチヤグラBOTの勝ち目がない経路候補ではLOS物理レイを呼ばない
items.reason: A lower-bound score rejection precedes LOS/jump-start work only when that candidate cannot beat the current best score. Survivors preserve original tie and route decisions.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ガチヤグラの毎更新・乗員オフセット配列とレコードを再利用
items.reason: Native Tower synchronization leases rider rows per recursion depth and clears actor references in finally. The public collector continues returning independent snapshots; overridden collectors keep their original path.

prior1870.reason: Scope crosses collect and sync callbacks; queue measured only 1.9% mock improvement. Retained record identity/reentry contract requires additional proof.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ranked-tower-route-position-binary-segment-lookup
items.reason: Route metrics.lengths is public and mutable, so a previously monotone route does not prove the current array is sorted. Binary lookup was reverted rather than silently changing edited-route behavior.

prior1870.reason: metrics.lengths remains externally mutable; immutable origin/monotonicity proof would need a contract change or per-call O(N) validation.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ranked-zone-coverage-skip-unrelated-off-zone-turf-versions
items.reason: The proposed off-zone shortcut has no complete invalidation coverage across all CPU/network paint mutations. A missed update would change scoring, so current coverage evaluation remains.

prior1870.reason: Needs complete tracking of all CPU grid writes and network restores; missing any invalidation changes authoritative 50/70% decisions.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ガチエリア：ゾーン判定境界をインデックス構築前に計算し、塗りセル反復での再計算を除去
items.reason: Static native zone bounds are prepared once for index construction; custom/mutable paths retain their live calculation.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ranked-zone-reuse-static-coverage-area-sums
items.reason: Coverage area sums are cached only for the canonical immutable published cell collection. Custom iterable/mutable data uses the original reduction.

prior1870.reason: Brand and freeze only engine-built static zone cell records, compute ordered total areas once, and fall back for external or replaced indices.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ガチエリア: 毎tickの全エリア支配判定を状態遷移ループへ統合
items.reason: Zone-transition callbacks can mutate a previously visited zone. The existing post-transition all-zone scan observes the final state; fusing it into the loop can score from stale earlier values.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] RibbonPool: 端点パディングによる不要なリボン頂点転送とインデックス描画を削減
items.reason: Packing live Ribbon topology changes GPU buffers/index offsets and upload ranges. Scalar parity alone does not establish identical rendering; the existing topology is retained.

prior1870.reason: Dynamic indices/topology/upload ranges need actual GPU raster equivalence and transfer benchmark; current dirty-view change leaves topology unchanged.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ribbon-pool-spacing-compare-squared-distance-with-threshold-fallback
items.reason: Ribbon spacing uses squared rejection away from the boundary and falls back to original hypot near rounding boundaries, overflow, underflow and nonfinite values. Real ring buffers and every GPU attribute match at 30/60/120Hz.

prior1870.reason: push retains original Math.hypot<spacing. Dirty chronological-view work is separate. Squared fastpath needs boundary, subnormal and signed/nonfinite behavior and branch-cost proof.

items.title: # [INKWAVE][Optimization][P3] Roller/Brush contact gate: avoid two square roots for clearly moving or zero vectors
items.reason: Clear-zero and guaranteed-motion gates avoid irrelevant hypot while retaining the original boundary computation and timer semantics.

prior1870.reason: Contact/holding region also changes in gameplay PR #1872; no overlapping speculative contact fastpath added.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ローラー横振り弾のfallbackリンク判定で明白な遠距離ペアの平方根計算を省略
items.reason: Roller fallback links reject finite axis-separated candidates before hypot and reuse the already computed coordinate deltas.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] roller-release-footpaint-reuse-depth-scoped-center-and-yaw-trig
items.reason: Footpaint centers escape to paint hooks, which may retain them. Reusing a depth-scoped center changes earlier observations; existing hit-probe pooling does not establish center ownership.

prior1870.reason: Center scratch requires retained-reference/reentrant paint validation; current fresh-center ownership is preserved.

items.title: # [INKWAVE][Optimization][P4] Splatana neutral-stick history: omit provably unnecessary aim-direction hypot
items.reason: Skipping neutral-stick heading work changes getter evaluation and signed-zero paths unless guarded. The additional guard cost has no demonstrated gain for this small branch; original calculation retained.

prior1870.reason: Signed-zero-preserving neutral fastpath needs real actor/input tracing and benchmark; leave original history expression.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] サブ/スペシャル設置物への範囲攻撃で同じ距離の平方根を二度計算
items.reason: AOE shares distance only when the native method is unchanged and both endpoint coordinates still match after LOS. Mutating LOS callbacks, method overrides and shape contacts recompute with the original behavior.

prior1870.reason: Both shared AoE paths still recompute distance after LOS. The second read observes synchronous LOS coordinate mutations; a safe no-mutation fallback contract is absent.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Shooter muzzle cosmetic: reuse burst phase/sine/cosine across render frames
items.reason: Each owned burst lazily caches its deterministic phase/trig values, including draw-cap growth and pooled overwrite invalidation. Every matrix and attribute matches the PR1878 baseline at 30/60/120Hz.

prior1870.reason: Pending: final append still calculates phase/sin/cos per visible droplet. Correct caching requires invalidation on each of 32 pool overwrites and per-index lazy warming that preserves cap ordering and does not spend extra trig on fully culled bursts. Current isolated audit model does not verify actual append matrix/shape/look output across pool overwrite and capacity-zero lifetimes.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Main-weapon shot-bias context creates a short-lived record per launch
items.reason: Launch-context records are supplied to external observers and can escape their call. A reentrant pool prevents nested overlap but still mutates retained contexts, so fresh records remain.

prior1870.reason: Pending: withShotBias intentionally creates a fresh record visible through weaponRunner.s3ShotBias during synchronous launch hooks. A depth pool would change reference identity and later mutate any record retained by a hook; complete composed-consumer escape/reentrancy proof is missing. Existing finally reference restoration remains intact.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Slosher: reuse original launch-angle sin/cos at deferred true birth if angle bit patterns remain unchanged
items.reason: Delayed Slosher births validate each live angle exactly where its original trig evaluation occurred. This preserves parameter getters that mutate yaw between velocity arguments, angle getters and exceptions. Each pooled birth resets the captured values.

prior1870.reason: Adding angle/trig cache fields to pooled rounds needs shape/memory and delayed-birth mutation evidence.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] スロッシャー中間飛沫で弾ごとに再解析する不変source planを共有
items.reason: Static source plans are cached by source identity while retaining PR1878 spacing and drawRadius outputs; projectile timing and live sample state remain separate.

prior1870.reason: Cache immutable static width/depth/spawn/drop plans by unit and source index with scalar invalidation. Source selection and all seeded per-projectile spacing still run for each glob.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Splatana horizontal splash fallback misses the source-identity cache on every admitted shot
items.reason: Canonical fallback Splatana splash specs are cached instead of recreated before each WeakMap lookup. Mutable custom source specs remain identity-specific.

prior1870.reason: Use a separate fallback-spec cache keyed by original source identity and checked scalar/nested inputs; explicit fallback gravity preserves the old spread override.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Splatling cosmetic tail: avoid saturated per-render square-root travel calculations
items.reason: The unguarded saturated-tail shortcut can bypass a custom distance method and introduces a new required distanceToSquared method. A fully proven native-vector ownership/guard path is absent; the speculative shortcut was reverted and the public fallback behavior preserved.

prior1870.reason: Extra vector identity/prototype/numeric guards can outweigh saved sqrt; unmeasured.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] インクストーム圏外/死亡者でも計算される雨の半径スケールを遅延評価
items.reason: Default rain scaling is evaluated only after a spatially eligible actor/object is found; explicitly supplied scales and eligible calls retain their values.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 友敵両方のストーム接触が確定した後も残りの雲でLOSを続行
items.reason: Storm status scanning stops after both team statuses are known, without skipping any needed recovery classification.

items.title: # [INKWAVE][Optimization][P2] スーパーシグナル（Super Chump）着弾プレビューの毎描画フレーム地形レイキャスト集中を除去
items.reason: Super Chump preview already reuses its vectors. Ground results must remain fresh for moving geometry and query callbacks, so caching the remaining probes lacks an invalidation contract.

prior1870.reason: Not adopted for query throttling: the existing owned preview vectors are already reused, but the same aim/physics objects can observe changed ground height on the next call. Keep all 14 fresh preview probes and independent launch vectors.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] SwimWakeの泳ぎ跡半径算出を二乗距離の最大選択＋Math.hypot 1回に変更
items.reason: Squared-distance ordering can differ from hypot near rounded ties and overflow. A conservative fallback plus GPU-bound acceptance is not established; current radius and culling behavior are retained.

prior1870.reason: Actual composed SwimWake.update still scans every eligible history point with Math.hypot. Existing !s.swimming guard removes the duplicated live head only; it does not select the farthest squared vector or provide the proposed nonfinite/boundary fallback.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] tacticooler-drink-vertical-broadphase-before-horizontal-hypot
items.reason: Exact vertical separation rejects clearly out-of-range drink candidates before horizontal hypot, preserving capsule edges, tolerance and nonfinite behavior.

items.title: # [INKWAVE][Optimization][P4] Tri-Slosher sourced splash visual: fast-path clearly nonzero horizontal heading
items.reason: Tri-Slosher heading skips the unused hypot only in the proven axis case; the usual heading calculation remains for all other trajectories.

prior1870.reason: Extra finite/type/axis branches can be slower than hypot. No browser workload benefit established; leave original guard.
